mission_02: Excellent! You have implemented differentiable reasoning over fuzzy truth values, enabling gradient-based optimization of logical constraints. Your fuzzy logic operators (product t-norm, probabilistic sum, Reichenbach implication) provide smooth approximations of boolean operations, and the recursive formula evaluator handles arbitrarily nested logical expressions. The gradient computation reveals how each input truth value should be adjusted to satisfy or violate a formula, bridging symbolic reasoning with neural learning. This is the core mechanism behind many neuro-symbolic approaches: using differentiable logic as a bridge between neural perception and symbolic reasoning.
